title: sophronitis × cipoensis
intro: Sophronitis × cipoensis, commonly known as Sophronitis, is a hybrid orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sophronitis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Sophronitis are primarily associated with its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help protect against oxidative stress and chronic diseases.
